english.title: Passenger fail to leave on journey completion or pay fare / produce permit / present smart medium for further journey
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a passenger on a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) used for the carriage of passengers at separate fares, at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), failed as soon as the journey was completed to leave the vehicle or

(A)_[pay the fare]_
(B)_[produce a permit]_
(C)_[present a smart medium]_

for the additional journey that you intended to take
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 7(2)(f) of the Public Service Vehicles (Conduct of Drivers, Inspectors, Conductors and Passengers) Regulations 1990 and section 25(3) of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981.
